mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rounds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS errors, COALESCE(AVG(elapsed_ms), 0) AS avgElapsedMs, COALESCE(AVG(total_tokens), 0) AS avgTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS rounds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS errors, COALESCE(AVG(elapsed_ms), 0) AS avgElapsedMs, COALESCE(AVG(total_tokens), 0) AS avgTokens FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT COALESCE(mode, '未知') AS mode, COUNT(*) AS rounds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS errors, COALESCE(AVG(elapsed_ms), 0) AS avgElapsedMs, COALESCE(AVG(total_tokens), 0) AS avgTokens FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY mode ORDER BY rounds DESC

SELECT COALESCE(route_source, '未知') AS routeSource, COUNT(*) AS rounds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS errors, COALESCE(AVG(elapsed_ms), 0) AS avgElapsedMs FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY route_source ORDER BY rounds DESC

SELECT COALESCE(agent_code, '通用助手') AS agentCode, COUNT(*) AS rounds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 END) AS errors, COALESCE(AVG(elapsed_ms), 0) AS avgElapsedMs, COALESCE(AVG(total_tokens), 0) AS avgTokens FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY agent_code ORDER BY rounds DESC

SELECT trace_id AS traceId, conversation_id AS conversationId, mode AS mode, route_source AS routeSource, agent_code AS agentCode, COALESCE(elapsed_ms, 0) AS elapsedMs, COALESCE(total_tokens, 0) AS totalTokens, status AS status, LEFT(user_message, 80) AS userMessage FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY elapsed_ms DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN self_eval_score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS evaluated, COUNT(CASE WHEN self_eval_score IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unevaluated, COUNT(CASE WHEN self_eval_score <= #{threshold} THEN 1 END) AS lowScore, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN self_eval_score IS NOT NULL THEN self_eval_score END), 0), 2) AS avgScore FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since}

SELECT trace_id AS traceId, conversation_id AS conversationId, mode AS mode, route_source AS routeSource, agent_code AS agentCode, COALESCE(elapsed_ms, 0) AS elapsedMs, self_eval_score AS selfEvalScore, LEFT(user_message, 80) AS userMessage FROM agent_trace WHERE created_at >= #{since} AND self_eval_score IS NOT NULL AND self_eval_score <= #{threshold} ORDER BY self_eval_score ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
